shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets show broad weakness with the Fear & Greed Index remaining in 'Fear' territory (27-34).
Mideast conflict escalation and new US tariffs (10-12.5%) push oil prices above $100, fueling inflation concerns.
Bitcoin spot ETFs saw $240 million in outflows on Friday, while Ethereum ETFs recorded $70.7 million in outflows.
Doubts are increasing over the passage of the US CLARITY Act, leading to continued regulatory uncertainty for crypto.
Two Ethereum bridges suffered hacks totaling $31.7 million, and a third protocol paused staking.
